```sql
SELECT SUM(cr.points) / COUNT(DISTINCT cr.raceId) AS avg_points_per_race
FROM main."constructors" c
JOIN main."constructorResults" cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
JOIN main."races" r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE c.name = 'Brawn'
  AND r.year = 2010
  AND r.date < '2010-07-01'
```
